correctness.rationale: After positive rescaling, every feasible allocation is described by an imbalance around the fixed mean. The exact derivative has the sign of a strictly convex quadratic in the squared imbalance, whose endpoint values have opposite signs precisely above a unique cubic threshold. This proves the unique global imbalance and excludes endpoints; quadratic discriminant gives the optimizer. The onset follows by an implicit derivative and high-load expansion by exact algebra. Standalone symbolic checker verified critical identities and 10,667 deterministic assertions. Limits and constraints are explicit; no finite run substitutes for the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Exact all-positive-parameter fixed-total two-site allocation, with a sharp cubic threshold, two asymmetric maximizers, square-root onset, and a single-site high-load asymptote, was not implied by the examined closest published statements. The closest accessible primary treatments concern different physical controls (mass transfer, serial reactor steady states) or one-site inhibition. Historical priority against general nonconcave two-point optimization remains provisional, not certified.
residual_risks: Generic convex-envelope/nonconcave moment-allocation theorems might imply the two-point fixed-budget formula without using Haldane terminology; direct full-text implication of that broad literature was not established.

The 1968 Andrews and 1996 Tan full texts were not materially inspected, so their full mathematical appendices cannot be excluded. The available abstracts point to different systems but do not prove noncoverage.
The constrained two-compartment objective is a stylized benchmark: single-site kinetics alone cannot justify system-level process control under dynamic mass transfer.

value.rationale: Fixed-total substrate sharing among two equally weighted, independent inhibitory compartments is a physically motivated but nonlinear design benchmark. The result separates the single-site inhibition peak from a strictly higher onset of beneficial heterogeneity, computes every optimal split, excludes full concentration in one compartment, and identifies square-root onset and high-load retention of one compartment at the individual-optimal concentration. This is an exact global phase diagram, not a relabeling or arbitrary numerical slice; it does not assert field-scale efficacy.
